text:
A swimmer feels cold after leaving warm water on a warm, windy day.
Why does she feel cold even though the air is warm?
A
The less energetic water molecules on her skin escape quickly.
B
The more energetic water molecules on her skin do not escape quickly.
C
The water on her skin does not evaporate quickly enough to keep her warm.
D
The water on her skin evaporates quickly and cools her skin.

options.label: A
options.text: The less energetic water molecules on her skin escape quickly.

options.label: B
options.text: The more energetic water molecules on her skin do not escape quickly.

options.label: C
options.text: The water on her skin does not evaporate quickly enough to keep her warm.

options.label: D
options.text: The water on her skin evaporates quickly and cools her skin.
